physics-killer-02.material: Wareeg toosan oo goobaabin ah oo radius $0$ ayaa lagu dhejiyay gunta (dherer $R=4\\,\\mathrm{m}$) waddo aan marayn. Shay $2\\,\\mathrm{kg}$ ah ayaa laga sii daayay nasasho waddada si uu u wareego wareegga. Isticmaal $g=10\\,\\mathrm{m/s^2}$. Doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, dhererka ugu yar ee sii daynta $h_{min}$ (laga cabbiray gunta) ee loo baahan yahay si loo dhaafo dhaladka wareegga iyada oo aan waddada laga tegin, iyo xoogga caadiga ah $15\\,\\mathrm{m}$ ee waddadu saarto shayga dhaladka marka dhererka sii daynta uu yahay $N$?
physics-killer-02.s.s1.prompt: Wareeg toosan oo goobaabin ah oo radius $0$ ayaa lagu dhejiyay gunta (dherer $R=4\\,\\mathrm{m}$) waddo aan marayn. Shay $2\\,\\mathrm{kg}$ ah ayaa laga sii daayay nasasho waddada si uu u wareego wareegga. Isticmaal $g=10\\,\\mathrm{m/s^2}$. Doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, dhererka ugu yar ee sii daynta $h_{min}$ (laga cabbiray gunta) ee loo baahan yahay si loo dhaafo dhaladka wareegga iyada oo aan waddada laga tegin, iyo xoogga caadiga ah $15\\,\\mathrm{m}$ ee waddadu saarto shayga dhaladka marka dhererka sii daynta uu yahay $N$?
physics-killer-02.s.s1.explain: Shuruudda ugu yar $N=0$: $mg=mv^2/R\Rightarrow v_{top}^2=gR=40$. Ilaalinta tamarta $mgh_{min}=mg(2R)+\frac12mv_{top}^2$ waxay bixisaa $h_{min}=2R+\dfrac{R}{2}=2.5R=10\,\mathrm{m}$. Marka $h=15\,\mathrm{m}$, $v_{top}^2=2g(h-2R)=2\cdot10\cdot7=140$. Laga bilaabo $mg+N=mv^2/R$, $N=m\left(\dfrac{v^2}{R}-g\right)=2(35-10)=50\,\mathrm{N}$. Isticmaalka dhererka $2R=8\,\mathrm{m}$ oo keliya waxay iska indho tirtaa tamarta kinetic-ka (doodda 1); $N=mv^2/R=70\,\mathrm{N}$ waxay iska indho tirtaa cuf-jiidadka (doodda 2); $90\,\mathrm{N}$ waa khalad calaamad oo ku daraya cuf-jiidadka (doodda 3).
physics-killer-02.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-02.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
